{{For|the Canadian river|Moïse River}}
'''Moise''' is a given name and   surname, with differing spellings in its French and Romanian origins, both of which originate from the name [[Moses (given name)|Moses]]: '''Moïse''' is the French spelling of Moses, while '''Moise''' is the Romanian spelling. As a surname, '''Moisè''' and '''Mosè''' are Italian spellings of Moses.{{TOC right}}
